text:
ravi: Heads-up team — planning a full go-live rehearsal next week focused on hardware-accelerated listings (NVIDIA cert'd bundles) + SI handoff. Want to cover: badge usage, co-branded quickstart, live demo failover, press embargos, and partner enablement webinar. Who can take which lane?
anna: I can run partner enablement webinar and record 3 short clips: setup, telemetry, troubleshooting. Prep checklist: slides + one-pager + recording script. Target Wed 11:00 PT.
kai: Engineering will own demo failover & rollback tests. Propose synthetic load test + feature-flag rollback with circuit breaker set to 2% error or sustained 200ms latency over baseline. Need test tokens from partners-bot.
julia: Marketing/legal here — will own badge usage + press embargo language. Legal note: NVIDIA requires logo guidelines + trademark approval. Send their logo usage doc asap. Also avoid milestone claims like "zero downtime" in copy.
nvidia-partner: Thanks — uploading NVIDIA branding kit to the shared assets thread. Also request a short partner spotlight section on the listing page (50-75 words) and co-branded quickstart.
partners-bot: NVIDIA kit uploaded: /assets/partners/nvidia-kit-2026.zip. Staging-token window open until 2026-03-24T23:59Z. Use /token rotate to request new tokens.
ravi: Great. Quick rehearsal agenda draft: 1) 10:00 PT pre-checks (CDN, auth, billing, badge render) 2) 10:20 PT demo: hardware-accelerated workflow 3) 10:40 PT fault-injection + rollback 4) 11:00 PT partner webinar dry-run 5) 11:30 PT debrief + action items.
anna: Will prepare slides + recording script by Tue EOD. Can someone own the webinar invite list (partners + SI leads + sales engineers)?
julia: Marketing will own invites. Please send list to me by Tue 15:00 PT.
kai: For failover tests I need a short runbook snippet and a grafana panel. Ill patch the runbook and post the panel link here when ready.
nvidia-partner: One more ask: can the marketplace tile highlight GPU SKUs and provide a quick toggle for "dedicated" vs "shared"? That helps customers pick the right listing.avi: Feature request noted — dev team to discuss UX feasibility. If not feasible for GA, well include SKU mapping in the FAQ.
julia: Press embargo: propose single embargo lift at 12:00 PT on launch day to avoid staggered leaks. Partners wanting regional announcements must coordinate with us. Legal will draft an embargo compliance note.
partners-bot: Reminder: calendar slot created for rehearsal: 2026-03-23T10:00:00-11:45-07:00. Invitations posted to channel.
kai: Dry-run tokens requested via /token rotate — partners-bot returned new tokens and confirmed expiry 2026-03-23T18:00Z.
anna: Webinar slides posted to /docs/marketplace/webinar-quickstart-v1.pdf. Recording script in comments.
julia: Added NVIDIA logo approvals to legal checklist. Also flagged trademark signoff needed by Wed 09:00 PT.
ravi: Action recap: anna -> webinar + recordings; kai -> demo failover & grafana panel; julia -> badges + embargo copy + invite list; nvidia-partner -> branding kit + spotlight copy. Well run full rehearsal Tue Wed? (two dry-runs) — confirm availability.
nvidia-partner: We can do Tue dry-run. Our SI lead will join.
partners-bot: Dry-run invites updated: Tue 2026-03-22T10:00 PT and Wed 2026-03-23T10:00 PT.
ravi: Perfect. If anyone spots missing legal/trademark approvals or missing assets, ping here immediately. Otherwise well mark lanes amber until the two dry-runs complete. :seat:
